description: Implementation of UserDao interface for user data access operations, including methods for fetching users by username and ID, listing users, and listing users by store. Uses QueryDSL for building type-safe JPQL queries.

classes.name: UserDaoImpl
classes.description: Repository implementation for user data access, extending generic entity DAO and implementing UserDao interface.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a User entity by username, joining associated groups, merchant store, and default language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a User entity by its ID with related associations.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Lists all users with associated groups, merchant store, and default language, ordered by ID.

methods.name: listUserByStore
methods.description: Lists users associated with a specific merchant store, ordered by ID.
